# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Added budget_helpers module (crates/tank_core/src/budget_helpers.rs) with step_and_inspect() wrapper, one-liner conservation assertions (assert_n_conserved, assert_c_conserved, assert_o2_balanced, assert_budget_balanced, assert_per_tick_balanced), BudgetInspector with system_deltas/largest_mover/per_tick_net query methods, and TANK_BUDGET_DEBUG=1 env-var debug output to stderr. Added 12 integration tests (crates/tank_core/tests/budget_helpers.rs) that retrofit closed-system conservation checks using the new helpers and demonstrate the full API including per-system delta inspection, per-tick granularity, and open-system action tracking. Fixed pre-existing compilation error in tank_scenarios (missing death_biomass_to_detritus_fraction field).

## Steps

1. [Completed] Created crates/tank_core/src/budget_helpers.rs with Element enum, SystemElementDelta struct, InspectionResult/BudgetInspector types, step_and_inspect() function, assertion API (assert_n_conserved, assert_c_conserved, assert_o2_balanced, assert_budget_balanced, assert_per_tick_balanced), query methods (system_deltas, per_tick_net, largest_mover, system_delta_in_tick, net_delta), and TANK_BUDGET_DEBUG env-var debug output with per-tick stderr summaries identifying largest movers per element.
2. [Completed] Exported budget_helpers module from crates/tank_core/src/lib.rs as a public module.
3. [Completed] Created crates/tank_core/tests/budget_helpers.rs with 12 tests: closed_system_n_and_c_conserved_via_helpers (retrofit of existing pattern), assert_budget_balanced_covers_all_three_elements, inspect_system_deltas_for_nitrogen, inspect_specific_system_in_specific_tick, largest_mover_identifies_dominant_system, water_change_shows_n_export_via_system_deltas, trim_plants_is_closed_system_via_helpers, step_and_inspect_returns_snapshot, multiple_inspections_are_independent, o2_balance_check_with_aeration, debug_output_does_not_panic, net_delta_accessor_matches_before_after.
4. [Completed] Fixed pre-existing compilation error: added missing death_biomass_to_detritus_fraction field (default 1.0) to tank_scenarios process_preset_to_params conversion.
5. [Completed] Ran cargo test (all 215 tests pass including 12 new), cargo clippy (clean), cargo fmt --check (clean).

## Validation Evidence

- cargo test: 215 tests pass across all crates (12 new in budget_helpers test file)
- cargo clippy: zero warnings
- cargo fmt --check: zero diffs
- closed_system_n_and_c_conserved_via_helpers test retrofits the existing closed-system conservation pattern using single-call assert_n_conserved/assert_c_conserved + assert_per_tick_balanced
- inspect_system_deltas_for_nitrogen verifies a test can see which system produced nitrogen movement in a given tick
- TANK_BUDGET_DEBUG env-var path exercised without panics (debug_output_does_not_panic test); actual stderr output verified manually with TANK_BUDGET_DEBUG=1
- Budget helpers compile with zero overhead when budget tracking is disabled (step_and_inspect enables tracking only when called; BudgetInspector is not constructed unless requested)
- All assertion functions are single-call (assert_n_conserved, assert_c_conserved, assert_o2_balanced, assert_budget_balanced, assert_per_tick_balanced) — no multi-line manual pool arithmetic needed
- Assertion API covers N conservation, C conservation, O2 demand balance, and generic per-element check via assert_budget_balanced(budget, Element::*, tolerance)

## Outstanding Risks

- TANK_BUDGET_DEBUG uses std::env::var which is checked on every step_and_inspect call; for extremely hot loops this could be cached, but the cost is negligible for test/debug scenarios
- BudgetInspector clones tick records from the ledger (via to_vec) to provide independent inspection windows; for very long simulations this allocation could be significant but is appropriate for test/debug use
- The pre-existing tank_scenarios compilation fix (death_biomass_to_detritus_fraction = 1.0 hardcoded) should eventually be driven by the tank_data preset if/when that field is added to the data layer
